title: SOUTHERN CHARM | Seacrest, FL | Five Star Properties
meta_description: Southern Charm - Luxury Vacation Rental on 30A with Community Pool Favorite Features:- Community Pool- Multiple Balconies
description_expanded: Southern Charm - Luxury Vacation Rental on 30A with Community Pool   Favorite Features: - Community Pool - Multiple Balconies - Three-minute Walk to Pool - Seven-minute Walk to Beach (Beach shuttle available) More about Southern Charm: Welcome to Southern Charm, a luxurious rental property nestled in the heart of Seacrest, Florida, boasting an inviting open concept and coastal design. This stunning vacation home is perfect for those seeking a relaxing beach getaway with family and friends. Sleeping 12 across four bedrooms and proximity to the community pool, this is the ideal location for multi-family groups! Upon entering Southern Charm, you'll be greeted by the charming and cozy living room. The space features a plush couch and a comfortable armchair, all adorned with soft, beach-inspired cushions. A large flat-screen TV hangs on the wall, offering a variety of entertainment options for your leisure time. In the TV console, you'll find an assortment of board games, ensuring endless fun-filled evenings with loved ones. Adjacent to the living room, you'll discover the elegant dining room, thoughtfully designed to accommodate up to eight guests. Whether it's a family dinner or a gathering of friends, this space provides the perfect setting for memorable meals and engaging conversations. The fully-equipped kitchen is perfect for any home cook, boasting sleek stainless steel appliances, complemented by stunning granite countertops. Prepare delicious meals with ease on the electric stove, and find everything you need to unleash your culinary skills. The kitchen's bright and airy atmosphere is bound to inspire creativity and add to the overall coastal charm of the house. Stepping outside, you'll be enchanted by the shaded grill area, providing a serene and comfortable spot for outdoor dining. Gather around the dining table, sip refreshing beverages, and savor delightful meals as you immerse yourself in the beautiful surroundings. This outdoor oasis is perfect for barbecues and al fresco gatherings, making it an excellent extension of the indoor living space. For those seeking leisure and recreation, a picturesque walking path leads from the backyard to the nearby community pool. Embrace the lush greenery and pleasant surroundings as you take a leisurely three-minute stroll to the pool area. This Lagoon pool is 12,000 square feet and is one of the largest in Florida. Complementing the lagoon pool area is a grassy amphitheater for year-round entertainment, including concerts, festivals, private events, and daytime activities like Bocce or Frisbee. This is a great place to unwind, cool off, and soak up the Florida sun. As you ascend to the third floor, you'll be greeted by an inviting living room. Furnished with a plush couch and a large TV, this area serves as a gathering spot for relaxation and entertainment. The third-floor living room also includes a sink and mini fridge, ensuring you have everything you need for snacks and drinks while enjoying your vacation. Connected to the living room is a grand balcony that overlooks the charming neighborhood and provides ample seating for everyone. Revel in breathtaking sunrises and sunsets, share laughter and stories with family and friends and create memories that will last a lifetime. One of the highlights of staying in Southern Charm is the proximity to the beach, just a 7-minute walk away from the shoreline. This means you can easily start your day with a leisurely stroll to the beach, basking in the early morning sun, and listening to the soothing sound of the waves crashing on the shore. A beach shuttle is also available for guests’ convenience. Beyond the beach, Seacrest offers a range of activities and attractions to explore. You can rent bicycles and ride along the scenic 30A bike path, which stretches along the coastline and passes through picturesque communities. There are also nearby nature trails, parks, and recreational areas to enjoy outdoor activities. In the evenings, you can experience the vibrant atmosphere of Seacrest and nearby towns. Discover local restaurants offering fresh seafood and delicious cuisine, browse unique boutiques and art galleries, or simply take a relaxing evening stroll along the beach to witness breathtaking sunsets. Overall, this is an ideal location for planning a relaxing and fun beach vacation, all you need is a little Southern Charm! Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: Queen Bed & Shared Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 3: King Bed, Twin over Twin Bunk with Private Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 4: King Bed with Private Balcony & Shared Bathroom with Shower.
